sloka: कच्चिन् न पर दारान् वा राज पुत्रः अभिमन्यते ।कस्मात् स दण्डक अरण्ये भ्रूणहा इव विवासितः ॥२-७२-४५॥
transliteration: kaccin na para dārān vā rāja putraḥ abhimanyate ।kasmāt sa daṇḍaka araṇye bhrūṇahā iva vivāsitaḥ ॥2-72-45॥

translations.english: I hope he did not covet another man's wife. Like a sinner who had slain a child in embryo why has he been banished to Dandaka forest?
